fns.desc: wpa_config_read(): when cfgp is non-NULL (caller-owned struct), 'config' is aliased to cfgp at line 461. On RegOpenKeyEx failure, 'os_free(config)' unconditionally frees the caller-owned cfgp struct instead of guarding with 'if (config != cfgp)' the way the sibling config_file.c implementation does (config_file.c:401,497). Caller retains a dangling cfgp pointer -> use-after-free/double-free risk in every caller that passes an existing wpa_config to wpa_config_read() on the Windows-registry backend.

Same missing 'config != cfgp' ownership guard on the errors-path 'wpa_config_free(config)' at the end of wpa_config_read(); frees caller-owned cfgp when errors occur while parsing, mirroring the line-478 defect.
